mapper.update: update bm_batch_record_component set is_deleted = 1 where record_item_id =#{itemId} and record_version_id =#{recordVersionId} and is_deleted = 0

UPDATE bm_batch_record_component SET `is_result` = 0, `formula_id` = NULL, `formula_field` = NULL, `formula_expression` = NULL, `formula_precision` = NULL, formula_type = NULL, `formula_config` = NULL WHERE `id` =#{componentId}
mapper.sql: select t1.id,t1.record_item_id, t1.record_version_id, t1.record_version, t1.record_id, t1.component_type, t1.component_name, t1.field_id, t1.component_number, t1.formula_precision, t1.is_result, t1.formula_id, t1.formula_expression, t1.formula_type, t1.round_code, t1.parent_id, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.create_by, t1.update_by, t1.is_deleted, t1.used, t1.date_type, t2.formula_field,t2.component_detail, t2.formula_config from bm_batch_record_component t1 left join bm_batch_record_component_detail t2 on t1.id = t2.id and t2.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: where t1.record_version_id = #{recordVersionId} and t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.is_result = 1

SELECT bm_batch_record_component_detail.component_detail as component_detail, bm_process_batch_record.process_version_id, bm_batch_record_component.record_item_id, bm_batch_record_component.field_id as field_id, bm_batch_record_component.* FROM bm_process_batch_record LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record_component on bm_batch_record_component.record_version_id = bm_process_batch_record.batch_record_version_id left join bm_batch_record_component_detail on bm_batch_record_component_detail.id = bm_batch_record_component.id where bm_batch_record_component.is_deleted = 0 AND
(process_version_id = #{item.processVersionId} and record_item_id = #{item.recordItemId} and field_id = #{item.fieldId})
SELECT distinct record_item_id FROM bm_batch_record_component WHERE field_id = #{fieldId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY record_item_id LIMIT 1

select bm_batch_record_component.id, bm_batch_record_component.record_item_id, bm_batch_record_component.record_version_id, bm_batch_record_component.record_version, bm_batch_record_component.record_id, bm_batch_record_component.component_type, bm_batch_record_component.component_name, bm_batch_record_component.field_id, bm_batch_record_component.component_number, bm_batch_record_component.formula_precision, bm_batch_record_component.is_result, bm_batch_record_component.formula_id, bm_batch_record_component.formula_field, bm_batch_record_component.formula_expression, bm_batch_record_component.formula_type, bm_batch_record_component.round_code, bm_batch_record_component.parent_id, bm_batch_record_component.create_time, bm_batch_record_component.update_time, bm_batch_record_component.create_by, bm_batch_record_component.update_by, bm_batch_record_component.is_deleted, bm_batch_record_component.used, bm_batch_record_component.date_type, bm_batch_record_component.formula_config , bm_batch_record_component_detail.component_detail from bm_batch_record_component left join bm_batch_record_component_detail on bm_batch_record_component.id = bm_batch_record_component_detail.id where bm_batch_record_component.is_deleted = 0
and bm_batch_record_component.parent_id in
#{parentId}
and 1 = 0
